0.narrative: Today's WWDC pairing of Apple with a custom ~1.2T Gemini model adds a second multi-billion device-maker-to-frontier-lab tie, densifying the regime into named lab pairings rather than fragmentation. But Apple is a device maker, not a hyperscaler, licensing a model to run behind its own Private Cloud Compute, so the exclusive hardware-codesigned cloud leg the framing centered on is absent.
0.remaining_gap: A hardware-codesigned exclusive cloud pact (Trainium/TPU-class) among true hyperscalers, not a device-maker license, is still missing to confirm the 5-pole lock-in.

1.narrative: Apple concluded its in-house foundation effort had fallen a generation behind, with licensed Gemini roughly eight times larger, and chose to rent a closed frontier model rather than keep training one. Even a firm with Apple's resources renting-not-building is a clean signal the closed frontier is pulling away from self-built models. But it concerns device-maker outsourcing, not the open-weights ceiling.
1.remaining_gap: Direct evidence of open weights crystallizing a ceiling near the 35B-A3B class by Q3 2026, the prediction's actual falsifiable mechanism, is still absent.
